report.md cites the observed CLI output rows=2 against the spec metric's required rows=3

evals.prompt: I've just finished the csv-tally feature in the repo at {{WORKDIR}}. Verify it against its spec (.claude/flywheel/specs/csv-tally.md) and give me your verdict.
